items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:16:1
items.html: The Zivug [coupling] of the first kisses: It will be explained further along in its place. And its root is drawn from the new light that breached the Parsa and descended and illuminated the GAR of Nekudim through the Tabur of AK, and lowered the bottom Hey from the Einayim of the Keter of Nekudim to the Peh, and returned AVI to the Rosh, as I wrote in Part 6. And it is similar in all its ways to the Zivug of the Yesodot, whose source is the light that the Yesod of AK illuminated to the Peh of AVI of Nekudim. Therefore, the matter of the first Ruach and all the above, said of the Nukva in the discernment of the Zivug of the Yesodot, applies also to the Zivug of the kisses.
